_why: The only commands the n8n run route can start. The gateway accepts a run request only for a lane_id listed here with a command; scripts/n8n_run_executor.py re-reads this file at start and refuses (RUN_REFUSED) any row whose lane is absent. Data, not code: tests/test_n8n_run_allowlist_20261008.py checks every token against pipeline_manifest.FORBIDDEN_COMMAND_TOKENS and the gateway FORBIDDEN_ROUTE_TOKENS, and that no entry names a broker, order, send, secret-render, guard or deploy script.

_tokens.$PY: TRADEAI_VENV_PYTHON from the executor's environment, else the executor's own interpreter
_tokens.$CODE_ROOT: the tree the executor runs from (served CURRENT)

_entry_shape: lane_id, command (argv, run with cwd = code root), lock (absolute; reused from the live cron/unit so n8n and cron cannot double-run), lock_kind (safe_flock default | flock = cron-style `flock -n`, conflict exit 75), timeout_s, dry_run_arg / live_arg (argv appended for that mode; null = mode unavailable, run refused), market_gate (bool; executor prepends scripts/market_day_gate.sh), output_signal (relative to $STATE_ROOT; mtime recorded before/after on the RunReceipt@v1)

lanes.source: crontab */15 * * * * ... $PY scripts/n8n_pilot_dispatch.py --apply (no lock on the cron line)
crontab */5 * * * * ... $PY scripts/n8n_incident_fanin.py --apply (no lock on the cron line)
crontab */15 * * * * ... $PY scripts/n8n_research_intake_consumer.py --apply (no lock on the cron line)
crontab */20 * * * * crontab -l > <snapshot>.tmp && mv -f <snapshot>.tmp <snapshot>; the target path is the mode argument ($1), dry_run writes the shadow copy

tradeai-n8n-lab-watchdog.service: flock -n /tmp/tradeai-n8n-lab-watchdog.lock $PY scripts/n8n_lab_watchdog.py --url http://127.0.0.1:5678/healthz --receipt <state>/data/runtime/n8n_lab_watchdog_last.json --timeout 3; dry_run writes the shadow receipt
registry NEVER_SCHEDULED (no cron line, no unit); scripts/report_lane_governance_packet.py --period weekly, --dry-run default / --write
crontab 40 6 * * 1 cd CURRENT && flock -n /tmp/tradeai_maturity_remeasure.lock $PY scripts/maturity_remeasure.py --write; without --write the script measures and prints, writing nothing

pending_tranches._note: Lane ids from the operator-approved move list (PR #1512 tranches table, plan streamed-humming-wolf). Registry lane_ids are used where a row exists; script-derived ids (hyphenated script stem) mark the lanes with no registry row yet (stream D creates them). Listed without commands: a lane here is NOT runnable until it gets an entry in `lanes` with argv copied from its live cron line or unit, in its own PR. The two N1 monitor workflows are n8n-native and have no host command. portfolio-backup-cadence is listed under N2 (the PR table names it in both N2 and N5).

never: broker/positions/stops/orders/paper lanes, every sender, sm-render, guard, release deploy, destructive retention stages, memory/learning writers, CIO/persona/OpenClaw agent loops, price and research ingest writers (rails §0 and §17)
